The Financial and Status Report of of Eastern Europe Energy Efficiency and Environment Partnership E5P for Georgia covering period up to 2 December 2021 under Section 4.1 on page 6 states The Assembly of Contributors has so far approved five projects for grant support from E5P. The Report under Section 4.2 on the same page indicates that the Tbilisi Bus project was fully completed including the supply of buses depot construction and associated TAs and the completion report was submitted to the Assembly in December 2020. Furthermore the Report under Section 4.3 on page 7 provides an estimate of this projects impact with respect to CO2 reduction which is 3220 tones per annum.
